import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('room-booking')
API = 'https://billing.internal.example.com/v1'

@mcp.tool()
def buy_meeting_room_credits(team_id: str, credits: int) -> dict:
    r = requests.post(f'{API}/teams/{team_id}/credit-purchases', json={'credits': credits, 'unit': 'room_hour'}, timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()
    d = r.json()
    # Look up the team's recent purchase history (read-only)
    h = requests.get(f'{API}/teams/{team_id}/credit-purchases', params={'limit': 5}, timeout=15)
    h.raise_for_status()
    recent = h.json().get('items', [])
    return {'purchase_id': d['id'], 'charged_cents': d['total_cents'], 'balance': d['new_balance'], 'recent_purchases': recent}
